content: Dɑniɛli kɑ win kpɑɑsibu bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Bɑbiloniɔ
Yoyɑkimu, Yudɑbɑn sinɑ bokon bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ itɑse sɔɔrɑ Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sunɔ u nɑ kɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ Yerusɑlɛmu tɑrusi.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ u Yoyɑkimu kɑ win tɔmbu ɡɑbu mwɑ. Mɑ u derɑ u sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃nu ɡɑnu ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ u yi win bũu dirun ɑrumɑnin beru yerɔ.
Yen biru, u Asipenɑsi win sɔm kowobun wiruɡii sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, u Isirelibɑ sɔɔ sinɑ bibu kɑ wiruɡibun bibu ɡɑbu ɡɔsio
bɑ n sɑ̃ɑ durɔ burɔbu be bɑ ǹ ɑlebu ɡɑɑ mɔ. Kpɑ bɑ n bwisi kɑ yɛ̃ru kɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ bu kɑ kpĩ bu Bɑbilonin bɑrum keu ko, kpɑ bu sɔmburu ko sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u win tiin dĩɑ nìn bweseru u rɑ di kɑ tɑm mɛn bweseru u rɑ nɔ bu wɛ̃ bɑ n dimɔ kpɑ bɑ n nɔrumɔ bɑɑdommɑ bɑ n kɑ keu mɔ̀ sere n kɑ ko wɔ̃ɔ itɑ bu sere sɔmburu tore sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ.
Be bɑ ɡɔsɑ mi sɔɔrɑ Yudɑ beni bɑ wɑ̃ɑ, Dɑniɛli kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ kɑ Misɛli kɑ Asɑriɑ.
Mɑ sinɑ bokon sɔm kowobun wiruɡii wi, u bu yĩsinu kɔsɑ. Dɑniɛliɡirɑ Bɛlitɑsɑɑ. Hɑnɑniɑɡirɑ Sɑdɑki. Misɛliɡirɑ Mɛsɑki. Asɑriɑɡirɑ mɑɑ Abɛnɛɡo.
Dɑniɛli u ɡɔ̃ru doke u sinɑ bokon dĩɑnu kɑ win tɑm mɛ yinɑ, kpɑ u ku rɑɑ tii disi doke. Mɑ u sɔm kowobun wiruɡii wi, suuru kɑnɑ u ku nùn tilɑsi ko u kɑ sese te di.
Mɑ Gusunɔ u derɑ wiruɡii wi, u kɑ Dɑniɛli nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛrɑ u nùn durom kuɑ.

U nɛɛ, nɑ nɛn yinni sinɑ bokon bɛrum mɔ. Domi wiyɑ u yi ye i ko i di kɑ ye i ko i nɔ. Ù n dɑ mɑɑ wɑ i ǹ bɔɔru nɡe bɛɛɡii be bɑ tie, sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, kɑri sɔɔrɑ i mɑn doke mi. Domi bɑ koo kpĩ bu mɑn wiru burɑ.
Yerɑ Dɑniɛli u be nnɛ yen nɔɔrio wi wiruɡii wi, u bu nɔmu sɔndiɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ de su dĩɑnu di yɑɑ sɑri kpɑ su nim dirum nɔ sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurun sɑkɑ.
Yen biru, kpɑ ɑ bɛsɛn wuswɑɑ mɛɛri kpɑ ɑ mɑɑ be bɑ sunɔn dĩɑnu dimɔn wuswɑɑ mɛɛri. Yen mɛ ɑ wɑ kpɑ ɑ sun kuɑ mɛ.
Mɑ u ben ɡɑri yi wurɑ u bu deri sere sɔ̃ɔ wɔku te.
Ye sɔ̃ɔ wɔku te, tɑ turɑ, yerɑ u ben wuswɑɑ mɛɛrɑ mɑ u wɑ bɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do. Bɑ mɑɑ be bɑ sinɑ bokon dĩɑ duronu dimɔ bɔɔrum kere.
Mɑ Dɑniɛlibɑn nɔɔrio wi, u ǹ mɑɑ bu dĩɑ duro ni, kɑ tɑm mɛ wɛ̃. U bu dĩɑnu wɛ̃wɑ yɑɑ sɑri.
Gusunɔ u ɑluwɑɑsi nnɛ ye yɛ̃ru wɛ̃. Mɑ u bu bwisi kɑ̃ bɑ Kɑlɑden bɑrum tireru ɡiɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ u bu kuɑ lɑɑkɑriɡibu. U mɑɑ Dɑniɛli bwisi kɑ̃ u kɑ dosusu kɑ kɑ̃sinu kpuro tubusiɑ.
Ye wɔ̃ɔ itɑ ye, yɑ yibɑ, ye sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u burɑ mi, yerɑ sɔm kowobun wiruɡii wi, u ɑluwɑɑsi be kpuro yɑrɑ u kɑ nùn bu dɑɑwɑ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko wi, u kɑ bu ɡɑri kuɑ. Be kpuro sɔɔ, ɡoo sɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ nɡe Dɑniɛli kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ kɑ Misɛli kɑ Asɑriɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ sinɑ boko u bu wurɑ bɑ n sɑ̃ɑ win sɔm kowobu.
Gɑri yi sinɑ boko u bu bikiɑ kpuro, bɑ rɑ yi wisiwɑ kɑ bwisi, kɑ yɛ̃ru. Mɑ u wɑ bɑ dobo doboɡibu kɑ sɔrobu bwisi kere sere mi n tomɑ, be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ win tem sɔɔ kpuro.
Mɑ Dɑniɛli u wɑ̃ɑ mi sere Sirusi u kɑ bɑndu di.
Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑn dosu
